verses.ar: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
verses.en: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain

verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةࣰ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرࣱ مُّسۡتَمِرࣱّ‏
verses.en: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرࣲ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
verses.en: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
verses.en: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter

verses.ar: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةࣱۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.en: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءࣲ نُّكُرٍ
verses.en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing

verses.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادࣱ مُّنتَشِرࣱ‏
verses.en: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad

verses.ar: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرࣱ‏
verses.en: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day

verses.ar: ۞كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونࣱ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
verses.en: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبࣱ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
verses.en: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help

verses.ar: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءࣲ مُّنۡهَمِرࣲ‏
verses.en: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

verses.ar: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونࣰ ا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣲ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
verses.en: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose

verses.ar: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحࣲ وَدُسُرࣲ‏
verses.en: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails

verses.ar: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءࣰ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.en: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected

verses.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
verses.en: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth

verses.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
verses.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادࣱ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحࣰ ا صَرۡصَرࣰ ا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسࣲ مُّسۡتَمِرࣲّ‏
verses.en: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity

verses.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲ‏
verses.en: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees

verses.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
verses.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

verses.ar: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرࣰ ا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدࣰ ا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.en: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness

verses.ar: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرࣱ‏
verses.en: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar

verses.ar: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدࣰ ا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
verses.en: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar

verses.ar: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةࣰ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
verses.en: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبࣲ مُّحۡتَضَرࣱ‏
verses.en: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed

verses.ar: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.en: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her)

verses.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
verses.en: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
verses.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: The folk of Lot rejected warnings

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطࣲۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرࣲ‏
verses.en: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night

verses.ar: نِّعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
verses.en: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابࣱ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
verses.en: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning

verses.ar: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: Now taste My punishment after My warnings

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
verses.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.en: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

verses.ar: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
verses.en: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful

verses.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةࣱ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.en: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures

verses.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعࣱ مُّنتَصِرࣱ‏
verses.en: Or say they: We are a host victorious

verses.ar: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.en: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.en: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure)

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرࣲ‏
verses.en: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.en: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell

verses.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرࣲ‏
verses.en: Lo! We have created every thing by measure

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةࣱ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
verses.en: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
verses.en: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءࣲ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.en: And every thing they did is in the scriptures

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرࣲ وَكَبِيرࣲ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
verses.en: And every small and great thing is recorded

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَهَرࣲ‏
verses.en: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers

verses.ar: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
verses.en: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King
